name: VM service
purpose: Lease-based disposable Tart VMs for AI agents on this Mac. POST /acquire clones a golden base (macOS 26 or Ubuntu 24.04), boots it headless over NAT, injects gateway credentials as env vars, and hands back a pristine machine with a TTL; exec/push/pull work inside the lease and release destroys it. Doctrines are enforced mechanically: at most 2 concurrent macOS guests (Virtualization.framework limit), NAT only, lifecycle-managed base/seed images never booted.
